summary: @LindaMitch2783 We Seek glory in no letters beyond those others master not teachers of writing more writers of teaching applying our pens of poetry to possibilities atop the pupils' paper #smallpoems #clmooc
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@LindaMitch2783
We
Seek glory in no letters
beyond those
others master
not
teachers of writing
more writers
     of teaching
applying our pens
   of poetry
to possibilities atop
the pupils' paper
#smallpoems
#clmooc
